name: Roboto
author: hmgupta8871
description:
A robot who had limited battery to survive, but the aliens are coming on his way, jump and survive. Avoid                               
      obstacles by jumping through a tap on the screen. 
Developed a visually captivating 3D game centered around a robot character with limited battery life.
Designed an immersive environment with a stylish blue-themed background, creating an engaging atmosphere.
Implemented obstacle-avoidance gameplay mechanics, where the player must navigate through a series of aliens to survive.
Introduced a strategic element by incorporating a limited battery feature, where collisions with aliens drain the robot's energy
